meta.title: Happy Qingqing
meta.description: Connects DeepSeek Harness to DaVinci Resolve Studio: 62 tools for environment checks, media archiving, timeline editing, color nodes with LUT/DRX, Fusion comps, and the Deliver queue, plus full inheritance of the official Resolve MCP's 18 capabilities. Bulk writes save the project and duplicate the timeline first.

pythonPath.label: Python interpreter
pythonPath.description: Leave empty to auto-detect (.venv → python → python3). Set the absolute path to python.exe if needed.

toolTimeoutMs.label: Tool timeout (ms)
toolTimeoutMs.description: Longest wait for a single Resolve operation. Keep render-heavy work above three minutes.

startupTimeoutMs.label: Bridge startup timeout (ms)
startupTimeoutMs.description: How long to wait for the Python bridge to boot; the first import is slower.

failOnStartupError.label: Block plugin load when the bridge fails
failOnStartupError.description: When off, a dead bridge only means no tools and never stalls DSH startup.

enabled.label: Enable the plugin
enabled.description: Turning this off hides every tool immediately while the plugin stays installed.

tools.qing_media_import_folder: Import a folder into the media pool
tools.qing_media_export_metadata: Export metadata CSV to learn the real column names
tools.qing_timeline_delete_markers: Delete markers by color, frame or custom data
tools.qing_timeline_mark_inout: Read, set or clear mark in and out
tools.qing_color_label_nodes: Label nodes and set their color
tools.qing_color_set_lut: Apply a 3D LUT to a node
tools.qing_color_grab_frame: Export the current frame for review
tools.qing_deliver_setup_job: Configure and queue a render job
